# Center for Strategic and International Studies (CSIS)

> > The Center for Strategic and International Studies (CSIS) is a bipartisan, nonprofit policy research organization in Washington, D.C., providing strategic insights and policy solutions to global challenges.

CSIS conducts research and hosts forums on international security, defense policy, regional studies, and energy policy, featuring world leaders, policymakers, and subject matter experts. Led by President and CEO John J. Hamre, CSIS programs include the International Security Program, Africa Program, and initiatives like the Brzezinski Institute on Geostrategy and the U.S.-Japan Commission on the Future of the Alliance.

## Key Topics

- International Security
- Defense Policy
- Asia-Pacific Security
- U.S.-Japan Alliance
- Africa Program
- Energy Policy
- Geostrategy
- National Security
- Bilateral Relations
- Cybersecurity and Malware
- Trans-Pacific Partnership
- Defense Budget and Space Policy
- Climate Change Policy
- Public-Private Partnerships
